verses.verse:
श्रुतिस्पर्शैः स्वरस्पर्शैः कम्पनैः भूषयेत् स्वरान्।
श्रवणेन परीक्ष्यैनम् तालेन परिशोधयेत्।१३८।
verses.text: One should adorn the notes with touches of śruti, touches of other notes and shakes; testing it by ear, one should refine it with the tāla.

commentary.text: That is, one should try to make the notes used in a song sweet by joining them sometimes with the touch of a śruti (mīṇḍ, glide), with the touch of other notes, and with actions such as kampana (shake). For the definition of śruti, here is the following śloka.
